acceptance_criteria: Settings validate root shape, supported types and ranges, migrations, and safe recovery while preserving invalid source.
Dangerous mode confirmation blocks Mutagen create on cancel.
Refresh errors preserve last valid snapshot and visibly mark stale/offline.
Async refresh generations prevent older results overwriting newer state.
Traffic history uses real measurement timestamps and a sample cadence separate from GUI refresh.
High-volume tables use model/view; benchmark includes 10, 100, 500, 1000 synthetic sessions.
CI self-test logs print and upload; push and PR run lightweight checks; packaging remains dispatch-only.
Opt-in isolated local Mutagen integration tests exist; SSH recovery requirements documented.
README has no fixed test counts; Ruff includes E9/F/B/I/UP/selected SIM; dependency scope evaluated; full export warns.
Relevant tests/checks run; Windows EXE, live daemon and SSH limits are explicit.
task_fixes.description: Implemented the MutaUI v8.2 remediation scope in docs/superpowers/specs/2026-11-12-mutaui-review-remediation.md. Verification: Ruff passed; 101 tests passed and 1 optional local-Mutagen test skipped because Mutagen CLI is unavailable; verify_source passed; diff check exited 0; packaged fast-folder and one-file Windows EXE self-tests both exited 0. SSH recovery procedure is documented but was not exercised.
task_fixes.title: Review remediation

acceptance_criteria: Review every user-facing page and navigation label for confusing language, unclear actions, inconsistent terminology, and discoverability gaps.
Dashboard counters route to Sync or Forwarding and matching state, with accurate per-kind counts.
Forwarding purpose explained in-page; unclear Endpoints label corrected; stray non-English UI label removed.
Any further high-impact UI gaps found in the review are fixed or explicitly reported.
Live logs and export formats remain faithful; unrelated local changes remain intact.
